set.notes: Methylation QTL claim: exposure = DNA methylation at cg16908938 mapped to GREB1 (paper's closest-TSS gene). Representative CpG = lowest P_SMR in Table 5. p_HEIDI (Table 5 'p_HET') 1.25E-01: HEIDI pass (threshold 0.01). Other CpGs for GREB1: none. Table 5 reports P values only (no b_SMR or SE), so estimate and direction are not available. Endometrial SMR: 4546 DNAm probe sites (Bonferroni-significant sentinel cis-mQTLs) tested; study-wide threshold P_SMR = 1.10e-5 (Methods) / 1.2e-5 (Results); HEIDI rejection if P_HEIDI < 0.05/m with m = 5 sites passing SMR (text: P_HEIDI > 0.01 not rejected). Also at the GREB1 locus: cg07314298, which the paper annotates to Metazoa_SRP (an Rfam SRP RNA element inside GREB1, not an HGNC gene, so no separate claim): top SNP rs28689909, p_SMR 7.93E-06, p_HEIDI 1.26E-02 (pass). Abstract names GREB1 as the one mQTL in a known endometriosis risk region; title frames 'gene targets' (headline set true; borderline). Table 4: GREB1 mSNP rs16857668 mQTL beta -0.3996 (cg16908938). Outcome: Sapkota 2017 meta-analysis summary data (ref 26), described in Methods as generated from ~15,000 European endometriosis cases; exact case/control numbers used not stated. Cohorts mapped from the Sapkota 2017 full text (local copy): its European arm is 14,926 cases / 189,715 controls from 8 datasets (QIMRHCS, OX, LEUVEN, deCODE, 23andMe, NHS2-dbGaP, WGHS, iPSYCH); 'other' = QIMRHCS, OX, LEUVEN, NHS2, WGHS, iPSYCH. Whether the summary data used included 23andMe is not stated; the ~15,000-case figure matches the European arm including it. [Adjudication: Headline set false: GREB1 is named only as the location of a risk region.]
